save.text: Subscriber giveaway at 4,200 -> winner LL1973; prize: signed PHB + signed cast photo (announced).
No CR next week due to San Diego Comic-Con; panel Thurs (main Geek & Sundry 1-2, CR panel 4-5) at PetCo Park; panel will be filmed and streamed later. (Matt)
Matt and Marisha will be in New Zealand the week after SDCC (two-week break from main-story CR); other available cast will stream/play. (Matt)
Intro video failed; cast decided to skip it and begin game live. (turns 75-76, 101-112, 124)
Sam (guest) joined the session mid-intro; cast acknowledged and welcomed them. (turns 131-139, 140)

Current story recap: Vox Machina retrieved Horn of Orcus from Underdark; it's indestructible; Council and party decided to seal it in Platinum Sanctuary in Vasselheim; traveling by skyship across Ozmit Sea to Othanzia; recently attacked by wyvern/griffin bandits; voyage ~6-7 days; party continued with Horn safe. (turns 130-139, 144-146)
Halfling mage rescued earlier is bound/locked in ship's anti-magic brig by Captain Damon due to prior attempted attack; fate pending. (confirmed by Matt)
Percy's reading; next few days pass without incident; party resting and spells regained; travel across Ozmit Sea continues. (Matt)

Grog (Travis) attempted to grow facial hair via magic: roll resulted in sparse translucent stubble ~1-1.5in; Marisha braided and decorated it; possible physiological concerns noted by Matt (goliaths rarely grow facial hair). (turns 172-196,201)
Grog's magically-grown goatee updated: now glorious dark brown, braided, 3-4 inches, proud reaction from Grog; others joked/sang. (turns 238-244)
Weather mid-sixth day: clouds form, colder northern weather; nature check (Keyleth) 20 -> slow formation, not arcane/stormfront. (turns 245-251)

Tiberius (Orion) successfully convinced Scanlan (Sam) to trade items: Scanlan agrees to trade his circlet/crown for Tiberius's Ioun Stone; friendly banter and demonstration (shale Wall of Stone failed briefly). (turns 265-316)
Tiberius convinced Scanlan to trade his circlet for Tiberius's Ioun Stone; Ioun Stone now orbits over Scanlan's head. (turns 265, 333-336)
Weather change mid-voyage: temperature dropped; light snow began falling from clouds ahead. (turns 350-351)

Keyleth (Marisha) mentioned Fire Ashari tribe located near Vasselheim in town of Pyrah; it's her sister tribe and part of Ashari network protecting planar bleed points; she may wish to visit after handling the Horn as part of her Aramente. (turns 356-376)

Keyleth's mother left when Keyleth was ~5-6; Keyleth doesn't remember much; Keyleth uncertain if mother alive. Cast plans to visit Keyleth's Ashari tribe near Vasselheim (Pyrah) when in region; party supportive. (turns 408-456)

Land sighted: Othanzia—Vesper Timberland forest with snowfall; singular mountain spire ~20-30 miles from shore with a heavily fortified city built into it (city ~1/3 larger than Emon) with layered walls and dragon-headed ballistae defenses; city appears a mix of new and ancient fortifications. (turns 457-473)
Kima present aboard ship; remarks 'Welcome to Othanzia' and notes Vesper Timberland leading to tundra north. Trinket reacting to cold. (turn 463)

Ship descends into Vasselheim; city shows repeated battle repairs and scars; landing platform atop a mill not usually for skyships; crew preparing ropes; Scalebearers and Kima carry Horn aboard. (turn 477)

Kima anxious about city arrival; offers to answer questions and expects escorts to guide party; characters note cold and gear up with winter cloaks previously purchased. (turns 543-546, 492-503, 500-505)
Scanlan stores a 3rd-level Lightning Bolt into his Ioun Stone (now humming greenish-blue); Matt confirmed spell slot still used but spell is saved in stone. (turn 528)
Kima nervous but confident; last with her Order 'proper' eight years ago; expects to meet them now. (turns 557-563, 568)

Arrived platform: Scalebearers escort party; Scalebearer Yonn (elderly bald man with spectacles, robe) identified; Yonn says Platinum Sanctuary ~25-minute walk; only Yonn, travelers, and Highbearer Vord know about Horn. (turns 566-586, 607-613, 619)
Kima's title confirmed as 'Lady Kima of Vord' (implying relationship to Highbearer Vord); Kima twitches when Vord's name spoken. (turns 614-616)
Vasselheim described as 'cradle of faith/Dawn City'; public displays of many deities' holy symbols (Arathis, Avandra, Melora, Bahamut noted); Sarenrae absent. (turns 635-640)

Scalebearer Yonn leads party off platform toward city stair; party decides tactical positions: Vex & Scanlan rooftop/sniper, Keyleth eagle form aerial support, Grog and Percy stay on path/ground, Tiberius rear following; Matt requests stealth checks. (turns 661-691)
City streets are thick, sleeted mud; populace rugged, furs/leathers, patchwork armor, stoic/grizzled appearance. (turn 713-715)
Vasselheim is ancient 'cradle of faith'; arcane is publicly profane/controlled; locals endure harsh life as devotion; city has oldest temples to major deities (Sarenrae absent). (turn 717)
Platinum box (Horn container) is ~1.5–2 ft square, solid platinum/silver with engravings and sapphires; people notice but don't gawk; guards still flanking party. (turns 725-738, 741)

Reached base of Platinum Sanctuary after 15–20 min stair ascent; fortress built into mountain, weathered stone, Draconic inscriptions ('honor, justice'); Bahamut shield-dragon symbol; three ivory/silver spires atop; massive gray marbled doors opened as Scalebearers approach. (turns 743-758)
City militia called 'Bastions' are volunteer civilian militia; ~25% of populace are Bastions; wear patchwork armor and patrol stairs/walls. (turn 770)

Forest near Vasselheim shows large, fast, serpentine multiple-bodied creature(s) moving beneath canopy ~1/4 mile out; ballista fired and creature retreated/stilled; such sightings are common. (turns 774-815)
Matt confirmed Matt & Marisha in New Zealand two-week break after SDCC; other cast will stream/play. (turn 12)

Kima asserts authority: identifying Keyleth as 'with me' caused Scalebearers to immediately remove shackles and defer; Kima referenced as 'Lady Kima of Vord' earlier. (turns 882-884; supports turn 13)

Scalebearer Yonn continues to lead party through a plain, ancient-scented temple of Bahamut; Pike senses strong divine energy—temple described as unusually 'holy' (humor: 'goes to six'). (turns 910-921)

Current story recap refined: In Platinum Sanctuary Highbearer Vord confirms the container holds one of the Horns of Orcus; he seals/acknowledges need to seal it immediately after divine confirmation. (turns 934-974)

Temple interior: central domed worship chamber ~80 ft high with massive creation-themed mural depicting elemental planes and Bahamut battling a five-headed chromatic dragon (Tiamat). Highbearer Vord greets group; Kima recognized by him as disciple. (turns 934-963)

Highbearer Vord described: slender elven male, very old, stark-white hair, wears draconic symbols with Bahamut emblem; introduced as 'Highbearer Vord' and 'Keeper of this most holy of places.' (turn 962)

Highbearer Vord explains Star of Exaltation (Bahamut relic) was created in War of the Beginnings, used as divine focus ~300 years ago during a siege and was expended/destroyed (not merely lost); chamber remains as sealing site. (turns 979-1006, 1008, 1026, 1034-1044)

Plan: party to enter Hall of the Exalt below, clear subterranean spider infestation and vault defenses; Scalebearers (including unreliable Yonn) will transport the reliquary (Horn) with the party into the vault to seal it. (turns 985-993, 1028-1031)
Scalebearer Yonn fled lower chambers after initiating vault defenses; acknowledged long service but absent now; party disparages him. (turns 981-991, 996-999)

Plan: party to enter Hall of the Exalt below, clear subterranean spider infestation and vault defenses; Scalebearers (including unreliable Yonn) will transport the reliquary (Horn) with the party into the vault to seal it.

Highbearer Vord explains Star of Exaltation (Bahamut relic) was created in War of the Beginnings, used as divine focus ~300 years ago during a siege and was expended/destroyed; chamber remains as sealing site.
No dragons detected within six-mile radius of the city per Keyleth's Primeval Awareness. (confirmed by Matt)
Party entered secret vault stair by Kima placing holy symbol into recess; wood illusion dispelled revealing stone doorway/staircase. (turn 1144)
Storage-area guards (5) in ceremonial armor stood and allowed passage when addressed; two visibly well-armed (greatsword, longsword). (turn 1141)

Vault chamber ~50x50 ft, ~20 ft high, filled with white mist produced by two central dragon-carved pillars; mist reforms quickly and emanates from dragon mouths; pillars' bases pivot. (turns 1160-1169, 1176-1189)

Party ran through mist barrier; Keyleth used two spells to clear mist path (first triggered dragon-mouth flames when Vax brushed mist; second cleared mist for remaining minute). Affected members: initial burst hit Keyleth, Scanlan, Tiberius (24 fire) and Vax, Tiberius took 12 each per saves; later passage used wind spell to hold open path. (turns 1215-1306)
Scalebearers accompany the party through the mist and are moving with them during the rush. (turns 1293-1296, 1305)

Scanlan failed his Dex save (13) and took full 24 fire damage; Keyleth also 24; Pike 24; Vax used Uncanny Dodge to reduce to 0; Tiberius and Orion (Percy) took 12 (half/other interpretations noted). (turns 1237-1277)

Party entered a circular chamber with multiple floor circles/pressure-plate pillars that pistoned into ceiling and rotated the room; Vax triggered it and took 40 crushing damage then recovered (acrobatics 22, 18, 23; used Luck once nat20 earlier to avoid initial hazard). (turns 1322-1376, 1379)
Vex shot a lighted arrow to reveal the room; Light spell on staff used to scout ahead. (turns 1322-1327)
Room contains a wide 20-foot staircase descending opposite the entry; no door. (turn 1340-1344)
Vax barely escaped rotating/pistoning room; likely broken ribs and serious bruising despite acrobatics 23 dodge. (turn 1387)

Opposite side of room/staircase descends; room functions as rotating grinding mill with pillars slamming ceiling intermittently; small quarter-coin-sized hole appears in ceiling at center where a pillar strikes, visible only when pillar retracts. (turns 1390-1406)

Vex (Percy and others) attempt precision shot: Vex preparing to shoot arrow into small ceiling hole (Robin Hood-level ricochet); party used Bardic Inspiration, Enhance Ability (mistakenly for attack), fake Grog beard item created; Tiberius readies ring/assists; Telekinesis invoked mid-shot. (turns 1414-1474)
Arrow ricocheted into a hidden slit in pillar; produced grinding metal debris and pillar scraping sound as internal mechanism engaged. (turns 1479-1485)
Party took a short rest after reaching other side; Vax and others used hit dice to heal; five-minute streaming break followed. (turns 1509-1516,1519-1523)
Guests Orion Acaba and Taylor Carol introduced; Taylor representing GameChanger shared personal cancer-survival backstory as part of charity segment. (turns 1549-1553)

Guests Orion Acaba and Taylor Carol introduced; Taylor (GameChanger) described founding after her cancer experience, charity gives games, hospital visits, scholarships; donation link and Deus Ex promo (turns 1556-1563,1569-1576,1588-1596,1607-1611).

Donation decision: Tonight's donations to go to GameChanger; Deus Ex promo: donate >$1 gets game; link in chat/mods; 826LA portion redirected to GameChanger per cast/announcement. (turns 1578-1586,1597-1601,1607-1611)
Short break occurred after guest segment; cast paused to 'break' and then returned with announcement/winner; website briefly crashed due to traffic. (turns 1595-1602,1603-1609)
